market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: In a 10-team IPL, even a weak team has about a 5-10% chance. KKR are the reigning champions and a strong franchise, so a 10% estimate is conservative. The market’s 1.1% implied probability is implausibly low, creating a large edge for betting Yes.
evidence_points: IPL has 10 teams with reasonable parity; the worst team still typically has a 3-5% chance, while top teams like KKR are 10%+.
KKR won the 2024 IPL and has a strong core, though the 2025 mega auction introduces uncertainty, the franchise consistently fields competitive sides.
Historical title odds: no IPL team has ever been as low as 1.1% preseason in a normal season.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of IPL auction cycles and team strength
